question: Liam started the weekend with 22 marbles in his collection. On Saturday morning he traded away 18 of them for a rare shooter marble his friend wanted. That afternoon he found a bag at a garage sale that made his remaining marbles grow to 7 times what he had. During a game with his cousin, Liam then won 41 more marbles fair and square. His neighbor Noah, who has been collecting for three years, mentioned that he currently owns 90 marbles, far more than Liam's pile. On Sunday, Liam's grandmother gave him 65 additional marbles she'd found in the attic. Meanwhile, the yard sale down the street sold 12 old bicycles that weekend. How many marbles does Liam have now?

A stationery warehouse begins the quarter with 220 pens in a single storage bin. A bulk shipment arrives and the bin's contents grow to 7 times their starting amount. The warehouse manager, Elena, then adds 69 more pens that were returned from a canceled order. A donation drive removes 907 pens to send to schools across the county. Elena's colleague Marcus, who runs a smaller warehouse across town, has just 150 pens on his own shelves, far fewer than what remains in Elena's bin. The remaining pens then grow again to 7 times what they had fallen to, after a second supplier restocks the shelves — a process that took about two hours, or 120 minutes, to complete. Finally, 64 more pens arrive from a late delivery truck. How many pens are in Elena's storage bin now?

Emma opens the school year with 172 dollars saved in her piggy bank, which comes out to exactly 17,200 cents if you counted it all in coins. She spends 78 dollars on a new bicycle helmet and safety gear. A generous birthday gift from her aunt then doubles what's left in her bank. A summer of babysitting jobs brings her total to 4 times what it had grown to. She then spends 380 dollars on a new laptop for school. How much money does Emma have left in her piggy bank?

In the morning, Farmer Joe collects 26 eggs from the henhouse. Later that morning, 18 eggs are set aside because they're cracked and unsellable. By early afternoon, a neighboring farm's hens unexpectedly triple what Joe has left after a mix-up with the delivery crates. In the late afternoon, 19 eggs break during transport to the market. That evening, a local diner returns 18 eggs it didn't end up needing for the day. How many eggs does Farmer Joe have by the end of the day?

Jordan starts the arcade night with 118 tickets tucked in his backpack. He spends 52 tickets on a round of skee-ball that doesn't go so well. A lucky claw machine win nets him 68 more tickets right after. His friend then hands him 69 tickets she won but didn't want, since she already picked out her prize. The arcade's giant prize wall, meanwhile, has exactly 240 stuffed animals on display, though most are far out of reach for a ticket count like his. Jordan trades in 186 tickets for a new pair of headphones at the prize counter. How many tickets does Jordan have left?

In the morning, Casey has 89 coins saved up in a phone game. Right after breakfast, a friend gifts her 27 more coins to help her finish a level. By late morning, a bonus multiplier event boosts her coin total to 7 times what it was. In the early afternoon, she splits her coins evenly across 4 different game accounts she manages for a clan event, and the story follows just one of those accounts afterward. The game, coincidentally, has 5,000 total players registered that week, though that has nothing to do with Casey's stash. Later in the afternoon, a special weekend event multiplies that one account's coins to 4 times what it had been. By evening, a second multiplier event during a livestream raises the coins to 6 times what they were. Right before bed, a final loyalty bonus brings her coins to 7 times their evening total. How many coins are in that one account now?

In the morning, an orchard crew picks 129 apples and sorts them into 3 equal-sized crates, and the rest of the day follows just one of those crates. By mid-morning, a second crew's harvest is combined in a way that brings that crate's count to 6 times what it held. In the early afternoon, 36 more apples are added after a late gathering round near the back fence. The orchard's cider press, elsewhere on the property, processed 500 apples that same morning, though those never touch this particular crate. By mid-afternoon, half of the crate's apples are set aside for a local school's field trip. Later that afternoon, 46 more apples are added from a final sweep of the trees. By evening, a bulk order from a farmers' market brings the crate's apples to 8 times what remained. How many apples are in that crate by the end of the day?

Grace has 106 stickers in her sticker book at the start of the week. She splits her sticker collection evenly with her little sister, keeping only her own share for herself. Later, 7 stickers get ruined when she accidentally drops the book in a puddle. Her cousin Mia, who has been collecting far longer, brags about having 200 stickers in her album, way more than what Grace has left. Grace then receives 36 new stickers from a cereal box promotion. She trades away 60 stickers at school for a rare holographic one. How many stickers does Grace have now?

Tyler owns 48 baseball cards at the start of summer break. He trades away 33 of them to complete his friend's set of rookie cards. A surprise pack purchase then brings his collection to 2 times what remained. His neighbor Owen, who's been collecting since he was little, has built up a stash of 120 cards, dwarfing Tyler's current count. Tyler then wins 11 more cards in a schoolyard trading contest. His uncle mails him 7 additional cards from an old collection he found in the garage. How many baseball cards does Tyler have now?

A courier company's central hub starts the day with 240 packages waiting to be sorted. A late-night delivery adds 8 more packages before the morning sort begins. A routing error then causes 71 packages to be sent to the wrong hub entirely. A holiday sales surge brings the hub's remaining packages to 5 times what they had fallen to, and the sorting team — a group of exactly a dozen workers — has to call in extra help just to keep up. The hub's driver Marco, whose van holds only 40 packages at full capacity, jokes that it could never carry everything piled up on the floor right now. Another 28 packages arrive that afternoon from a partner courier service. That evening, after the shift's sorting time is converted from minutes into hours for the report, 801 packages are shipped out to their final destinations before the doors close. How many packages remain at the hub at closing time?

A local bakery's Instagram post starts with 22 likes within the first hour of being posted. A popular food blogger reshares it, and the likes grow to 8 times what they were. A dozen of the bakery's regular customers happen to comment on the post too, though that has nothing to do with the like count. Overnight, the post gets featured on a trending page, and the likes grow again to 6 times what they had reached. The next morning, a second influencer's repost pushes the likes to 7 times their overnight total. By that afternoon, the post going viral on another platform brings the likes to 6 times what they had climbed to. How many likes does the bakery's post have by that afternoon?

In the morning, Aiden has 94 dollars saved in his desk drawer, which he always mentally counts as 9,400 cents just for fun. By midday, he earns 79 more dollars from mowing lawns around the neighborhood. In the early afternoon, he spends 102 dollars on a new bike helmet and lock. His sister Zoe, who has been saving separately, has only 60 dollars in her own jar, far behind her brother's total. By late afternoon, a matching bonus from his parents brings his savings to 5 times what remained after the bike purchase. That evening, a second matching bonus from his grandparents brings his total to 5 times what it had grown to. How much money does Aiden have saved by the end of the day?

A charity's donation tracker starts the week at 190 dollars, which the treasurer likes to point out is exactly 19,000 cents when you count every coin. A matching-donor pledge brings the tracker to 9 times its starting total. A bake sale on Tuesday adds 56 more dollars to the pot. On Wednesday, exactly a dozen volunteers help process a batch of refunds, and 1,317 dollars have to be returned to donors whose cards were mistakenly charged twice. On Thursday, 176 dollars are spent on printing costs for the year-end thank-you letters. On Friday, a final walk-in donation adds 53 dollars to the total. How much money is in the charity's donation tracker by the end of the week?

In the morning, a food truck's cash register has 193 dollars left over from the previous night's shift. By mid-morning, the breakfast rush brings in 24 more dollars. At lunchtime, the owner pays 56 dollars to a supplier who drops off fresh ingredients. In the early afternoon, 60 dollars is spent on a generator repair after it sputters out. The owner's business partner, Renee, who runs a second truck across town, texts that her register only has 150 dollars today, quite a bit less. By evening, a busy dinner rush brings the register's total to 5 times what it had fallen to. Right before closing, a regular customer tips an extra 16 dollars on their way out. How much money is in the register by closing time?

In the morning, a toy drive bin at the community center already holds 167 toys collected the day before. A dozen volunteers show up to help sort donations, though that headcount has nothing to do with how many toys come in. By midday, a school group drops off 73 more toys. Later that afternoon, a nearby daycare adds 33 more toys to the bin. In the early evening, a local business donates 67 toys during a special drive. Right before the center closes for the night, a matching-donation pledge brings the bin's total to 6 times what it had reached. How many toys are in the bin by closing time?

Sofia has practiced piano for 25 minutes so far this week, which comes out to exactly 1,500 seconds if you convert it. A weekend practice marathon brings her total time to 8 times what it was. She then practices for 13 more minutes on Monday after school. On Tuesday, she adds another 4 minutes before dinner. On Wednesday, a full extra session adds 74 more minutes to her total. How many minutes has Sofia practiced piano this week?

In the morning, a beekeeper counts 28 bees in a newly split hive. By midday, 7 bees are lost after a brief cold snap. In the early afternoon, the queen's egg-laying surge brings the hive's population to 7 times what remained. By late afternoon, an unusually warm spell brings the population to 8 times what it had grown to. By evening, a swarm merges into the hive, bringing its population to 8 times what it was. How many bees are in the hive by evening?

A coin collector has 140 rare coins in his display case at the start of spring. A quick trade at a local shop adds 4 more coins to the case. A dozen fellow collectors show up to a swap meet that weekend, though that number has nothing to do with his coin count. A big auction win brings his collection to 8 times what it was. He then splits his collection evenly across 4 identical display cases, and the story follows just one of those cases from here on. A final donation from a retiring collector brings that case's coins to 9 times what it held. How many coins are in that one display case now?

A hardware factory's storage bin holds 122 boxes of screws at the start of the shift. A morning production run adds 35 more boxes. A second run adds 65 more boxes shortly after. An automated packing surge brings the bin's total to 8 times what it had grown to. The factory's break room, meanwhile, ordered 200 sandwiches for the week's shifts, unrelated to the screw count. A late afternoon shipment adds 48 more boxes to the bin. A final rush order from a hardware chain brings the bin's total to 5 times what it had reached, all logged in a warehouse system that records weights in kilograms and converts them to pounds for the shipping label. How many boxes of screws are in the bin now?

Marcus has read 72 pages of his summer reading book by Monday. On Tuesday, he reads 70 more pages during a long car ride. On Wednesday, he reads 47 more pages before bed. A dozen kids in his class are doing the same reading challenge, though that number has nothing to do with his own page count. On Thursday, he reads 65 more pages during a rainy afternoon. On Friday, he skips 30 pages of an appendix section he doesn't need for his book report. A weekend re-reading of key chapters brings his effective page count to 6 times what it had been. How many pages has Marcus read now?

A concert venue starts ticket sales with 105 tickets already reserved for VIP guests. A presale event brings that number to 7 times what it was. A general sale then brings the reserved count to 8 times what it had grown to. A processing error causes 5,128 of those tickets to be released back into general inventory by mistake. The remaining reserved tickets are then split evenly between the venue's two VIP entrances, and the story follows just one entrance's list. Finally, 64 names are removed from that entrance's list after a late round of cancellations that took 55 minutes, just under an hour, to fully process. How many names remain on that one entrance's list?

In the morning, a food bank has 181 canned goods on its shelves. By midday, a school donation drive adds 74 more cans. In the early afternoon, a grocery store adds 28 more cans from its overstock. By late afternoon, a community-wide donation event brings the shelves to 6 times what they had grown to. That evening, a matching corporate pledge triples the shelves' contents once more. Right before closing, 658 cans are distributed to families in need. How many cans remain on the shelves after distribution?

A grain silo starts harvest season with 218 bushels of wheat stored inside. A record harvest brings the silo's contents to 5 times what it was. A neighboring farm delivers 48 more bushels to be stored temporarily. A large order for a flour mill removes 275 bushels. A second mill order takes another 649 bushels. A final small order for a local bakery removes 71 more bushels. How many bushels of wheat are left in the silo?

In the morning, a construction site has 202 bricks stacked and ready, delivered the night before in a shipment weighing just over 4 tons, or roughly 8,000 pounds. By midday, a bulk delivery brings the site's brick count to 5 times what it was. In the early afternoon, 199 bricks are used to finish a section of the retaining wall. By late afternoon, 32 more bricks arrive from a supplier correcting an earlier shortage. By evening, a final rush delivery for tomorrow's work brings the count to 9 times what it had grown to. How many bricks are on site by the end of the day?

A lab technician starts an experiment with 37 bacteria cells in a petri dish, recorded at exactly 9:00 in the morning. After the first growth cycle, which takes 90 minutes — an hour and a half — the population grows to 4 times what it was. After a second growth cycle, the population grows to 2 times its size again. A third cycle brings the population to 6 times what it had reached. A fourth cycle brings it to 8 times its size. A contamination event forces the technician to add 20 cells from a backup culture to keep the experiment viable. A final growth cycle before the experiment ends brings the population to 2 times what it had grown to. How many bacteria cells are in the dish at the end of the experiment?
